tbesh_html:
1) to pour, run, flow, pour down
1a) (Niphal)
1a1) to be poured, be spilt
1a2) to pour oneself, flow, trickle
1a3) to vanish (fig.)
1a4) to be stretched out
1b) (Hiphil) to pour down
1c) (Hophal) to melt

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over
strongs_1890.kjv_def: fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.
